data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/intent-v60.json
data_cdn_meta.description: JSON Schema for intent.yaml (Stage 1 onboarding output). Validates verb enumeration + landmark mapping + per-verb metadata (depends_on_view, recipe_outline, requires_state, fixture_dependencies).

title: Spec 60 intent.yaml
description: Output of stage 1 onboarding (research). Enumerates verbs, landmarks, and per-verb metadata.

verbs.description: Every canonical user action a normal user performs in this SaaS, mapped to verbs.

landmarks.description: Canonical screens the verbs depend on. Each landmark has a URL + verify selectors so the discovery phase can reach it.

research_log.description: Web searches the LLM ran during authoring. Auditable record for prompt iteration.

oneOf.description: Bare verb name (legacy v1 plain-string form).

depends_on_view.description: Landmark name the verb fires from. Must reference one of the entries in `landmarks`. Use 'any' when the verb runs anywhere.

recipe_outline.description: Named steps the recipe must perform, in order. The propose prompt copies this into actions/<verb>.yaml so heal can verify alignment.

oneOf.description: Predicate map describing prerequisite entity / UI state. Carried into test catalog as seed_state.

fixture_dependencies.description: Entities the test harness should auto-create before this verb's tests. Carried into test catalog as seed_fixtures.

notes.description: Optional inline comment for the propose prompt (gotchas, platform conventions).

url.description: Prefer deeplinks (?action=compose, #deep-link/state) over click-from-base-page navigation. Deeplinks are deterministic; click-driven nav adds heal cycles.

frame.description: When the landmark is iframe-embedded (e.g. Outlook hosting To Do), this is a URL substring used to locate the iframe in page.frames().

notes.description: Optional. State-dependent landmarks (need a fixture row, an open dialog, etc.) MUST flag here.
